title: Bootstrap pnpm monorepo

context.summary: Create pnpm workspace configuration, TypeScript base configuration, workspace app/package skeletons and basic repository validation scripts.
context.background: TASK-1 established the operating model. TASK-2 prepares the monorepo structure required before adding services, schemas or runtime implementation.

in: Initialize git metadata and create the TASK-2 task branch.
Create root package manager configuration for pnpm.
Create TypeScript base and root project reference configuration.
Create app and package workspace skeletons from the PRD target structure.
Create minimal placeholder TypeScript entrypoints without product behavior.
Create basic lint, typecheck, test, task validation and workspace validation scripts.
Update README and docs for the monorepo bootstrap.
out: Install third-party dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: Repository is initialized as a git repository and the active branch is task/TASK-2-bootstrap-pnpm-monorepo.
tasks/tasks.json sets current_task_id to TASK-2 and registers tasks/TASK-2.json.
Root package manager config exists for pnpm.
Root TypeScript base config and project references exist.
Workspace skeletons exist for API, MCP, CLI, worker, Hermes adapter and all PRD packages.
Each workspace has package.json, tsconfig.json and a minimal src/index.ts placeholder.
Root scripts exist for check, lint, typecheck, test, tasks:validate and workspace:validate.
Documentation reflects the monorepo bootstrap without duplicating the PRD.
No runtime product implementation is added.

manual_checks: Confirm workspace placeholders contain no product behavior.
Confirm no Docker Compose, API, database, worker, MCP, CLI or Hermes runtime implementation was added.

risks: Local pnpm is not available in the current environment, so dependency installation and real tsc execution may need to wait until pnpm is installed.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
